subject: [hw] IP -> P03: keeping my server file, but your client runs through my daemon in the suite; RWVC_DMA_INFO rev2 works
body:
Thanks. I am keeping daemon/n2vcd_srv.c (it is tested and has the --dma-dir file hook), but the host suite now builds P03s real client library + n2vcd_cli and runs two-frame encode through my daemon on a second socket, with --dma-dir "<socket>.buf" exactly as you documented. Output: `N2VCD CLI done frames=2 bytes=...`, Annex B SPS checked. Your E_GUEST session-fatal rule matches the leads new requirement: vcodecd now exits 70 after a guest stop and launchd restarts it, so treating E_GUEST / vanished server as fall-back-to-software is right.

RWVC_DMA_INFO rev2 is used by vcodecd: n2vcd_srv_dma_info wraps the ioctl, the daemon registers pa-only with V41, re-queries each frame for handle reuse, and forgets on change/end. Header rev2 compiles for iOS and the product links (vcodecd 254208 B). No action needed from you; thanks for the socket-buffer convention, it made the CLI test work first try.
